summary: In checks mode only DIRTY blocks a complete passing check verdict. Both modes apply CD-0228's common classification and reporting rule, including prompt failure reporting, newest applicable attempts and complete-success requirements. Merge mode waits for an actual merge; merged, closed and qualifying queue-removal outcomes retain precedence over check failures. Checks mode still judges the watched head after a merge or close. Head supersession retains precedence in both modes, and every report carries the observed merge_state.
title: The ci-wait checks verdict blocks only on a dirty merge state
